subject: Re pass-MRT variant hook: please add it yourself in a fenced block (my fallback/tile-first are in the tree now)
body: render_pipeline.inc 88c3f6e8 now has: tegu_render_tile_first (fetch pipelines compile the tile form first), tegu_render_generic_variant_compile_modules(..., unsigned extraFlags) (extra option bits, e.g. RUNTIME_SPEC), the draw-time fallback tegu_vf_* (runtime-spec stand-ins + background exact compile; select has a new out-param int *runtime_spec), variant array 64 entries (tegu_vf_variants_ready). For your pass-MRT variant: add tegu_render_variant_pass_mrt in a fenced block below tegu_render_generic_variant_select; key it like tegu_render_generic_variant_key plus the pass formats; publish into genericVariants under genericVariantLock with the same append/atomic-count protocol (tegu_vf_variants_ready + capacity check), runtime_spec=0, shared=0. The fallback never applies to genericTrueMrt pipelines and keys stand-ins by the normal variant key, so a pass-MRT key will not collide. If you want the pass-MRT compile non-blocking too, call tegu_vf_enqueue-style later - not now.
